notes.title: AI Remake & Afterlife Updates! - PATCH #2
notes.notes:
Hey, peasants!

[h1]NEW HEAVEN & HELL![/h1]
Heaven and hell maps were staying as concepts. They are now completed and ready to be played with a lot of unlockables to discover!
(Only Earth is available in the demo)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/3f93d6f14a86d71aaecbcfdd564be6b6f58d56e8.png[/img]

[h1]NEW CARAVAN MARKET![/h1]
Caravan wasn't available in the previous demo.
You can unlock new resources, furnitures or recruit special workers from the caravan.
Caravan comes at the beginning of the each season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/89de5d36e5c9926d9f67ff3e6cd45af661e22ca4.png[/img]

[h1]NEW WORKER AI![/h1]
Worker AI system remade from stratch.
Devil and angel workers are now available to buy from caravans!
Devils are better in cooking and angels are better in serving.

With the new worker furniture UI, you can see the worker limits of the work furnitures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/6a8187d50851ed13fc8d5c0f5b17195f93de905d.png[/img]

[h1]NEW CHARACTER TYPES![/h1]
Added a lot of character types that spawns according to the current season of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/70f24c90aba7716e593bd03c51a2d4b8dae3cb69.png[/img]

[h1]NEW RESOURCES![/h1]
Added a lot of unlockable resources!

Meat and Wheat available to unlock in Earth.
Red Pepper and Banana available to unlock in Caravan markets.
Golden Apple and Honey available to unlock in Heaven.
Devil's Horn and Bone available to unlock in Hell.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/934e797c71af50fda9b3568f12f953f1073de7f2.png[/img]

[h1]ADDED GERMAN TRANSLATION![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937914/428bbcc9e92ae03c910ce5016261dbb8fbe88cf8.png[/img]

[h1]ABOUT THE DEMO:[/h1]
Demo is currently unavailable to play due to missing features. We'll release the demo with Patch #3 soon!
With Patch #3, we are going to add missions, random events and level system to the game.

[h1]OTHER CHANGES:[/h1]
NEW!: Furnitures are now movable after placing them!
NEW!: Upper floors are locked and player needs to pay to unlock them.
NEW!: Players were waiting on the frozen screen after clicking "Play" button. Added loading screen to the game.
IMPROVEMENT: Improved the coin earning effects.
IMPROVEMENT: Improved the worker grabbing effect/post process.
IMPROVEMENT: Improved the tutorial dialogue screen.
IMPROVEMENT: Added idle animation variations.
IMPROVEMENT: Added camera borders to keep the player in the playable area.
IMPROVEMENT: Added locked effect to the locked resources in brewing scene.
IMPROVEMENT: Changed the old resource models with smoother ones.
FIX: Fixed a lot of issues about worker & customer AI.
FIX: Customers that goes to toilet or bed weren't giving coins.

Stay tuned for the demo!
Ashina Studios

notes.title: A Restoration to our Tavern! - PATCH #1
notes.notes:
Hey, peasants!

Thanks for your interest in our demo.
It's time for a update for your tavern!

[h1]NEW CHARACTERS!![/h1]

We completely changed the character style to make it more stylistic and increase their details.
New customer styles that spawn according to the game's season is going to be added with next update!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44937914/467264204dd94961f4082bf5e67a61c84720dd6e.png[/img]

[h1]Here's the latest fixes/additions:[/h1]

IMPROVEMENT: Added new sitting animation variations.
IMPROVEMENT: Changed the button icons to make it more suitable for the wooden buttons.
IMPROVEMENT: Upper floors' support column size adjusted.
OPTIMIZATION: Optimized the furniture destroy effect.
FIXED: Tutorial was getting stuck on the "waiting for customers" mission.
FIXED: Tutorial wasn't locking the grids properly.
FIXED: Player was able to close the building menu in tutorial. (It wasn't possible to open it again)
FIXED: Bartender and chef was sometimes getting stuck.
FIXED: If player destroys a floor in second or higher floor, customers were getting stuck on air.
FIXED: Bigger storage wasn't giving bigger storage. It's value was same with the smaller one.
FIXED: Firing workers was locking the work furniture.
FIXED: Camera was moving while typing in Bug Report Menu.
